message.content:
This editorial illustration features a light blue background. At the top, the white word "TEMPO" is partially obscured by a red rectangle. A man with glasses, wearing a long-sleeved grey shirt and dark trousers, stands on the left side. He looks upward while grasping a thick black rope that loops around his feet and extends toward a vertical grey pole. Attached to the top of the pole is a red 100,000 Rupiah banknote instead of a traditional flag.

Text on the upper left reads "Jual Murah Tambang Sitaan Korupsi Jiwasraya H.72." Text on the upper right reads "Jalur Berbelit Impor Bawang Putih H.84." The central headline is "KAMPUS (BELUM) MERDEKA." Accompanying text states: "Menteri Nadiem Makarim makin membuka komersialisasi pendidikan tinggi. Penetapan uang kuliah tunggal yang mahal tak transparan. H.30." The bottom right corner contains a barcode, a QR code, the date "27 MEI-2 JUNI 2024," the price "RP 50.000," and the website "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO." The man's hands are positioned one above the other on the rope.
